concepts.def: Shows the elements and number of atoms in a substance.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Formulae & Equations — a core area of GCSE Chemistry.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Formulae & Equations brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Formulae & Equations.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Sodium has atomic number 11. Its electron configuration is:
An atom of Mg loses 2 electrons to form Mg²⁺. Its number of protons is:
What does the M+ peak in a mass spectrum represent?
options: The molecular ion — formed when a single electron is removed from the whole molecule, giving the relative molecular mass.
Kc is always dimensionless.
The M+ peak shows the mass of a single hydrogen atom added to the molecule.
The M+ peak shows the mass of the largest fragment after the molecule breaks apart.

mcqs.q: What are the units of Kc for a reaction?
options: They depend on Δn (the difference between moles of gaseous/aqueous products and reactants) — Kc can be dimensionless or have units like mol dm^-3.
Kc always has units of mol dm^-3.
Kc is always dimensionless.
The M+ peak shows the mass of a single hydrogen atom added to the molecule.

mcqs.q: What is reduction in terms of electrons?
options: Reduction means a substance becomes physically smaller in size.
Reduction means losing oxygen and oxidation means gaining oxygen — full stop.
Kc is always dimensionless.
Gain of electrons (the oxidation number is reduced).

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Electron configuration”?
options: Number of protons in the nucleus; defines the element.
Arrangement of electrons in shells: 2, 8, 8 for the first three shells.
Smallest unit of an element; consists of a nucleus of protons and neutrons surrounded by electrons.
Average mass of atoms of an element compared to 1/12 the mass of a C-12 atom.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Relative atomic mass”?
options: Number of protons in the nucleus; defines the element.
Smallest unit of an element; consists of a nucleus of protons and neutrons surrounded by electrons.
Total number of protons and neutrons in the nucleus.
Average mass of atoms of an element compared to 1/12 the mass of a C-12 atom.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Ion”?
options: Smallest unit of an element; consists of a nucleus of protons and neutrons surrounded by electrons.
Atom or group of atoms with an overall charge from losing or gaining electrons.
Arrangement of electrons in shells: 2, 8, 8 for the first three shells.
Total number of protons and neutrons in the nucleus.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Atomic number”?
options: Number of protons in the nucleus; defines the element.
Arrangement of electrons in shells: 2, 8, 8 for the first three shells.
Total number of protons and neutrons in the nucleus.
Smallest unit of an element; consists of a nucleus of protons and neutrons surrounded by electrons.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Mass number”?
options: Arrangement of electrons in shells: 2, 8, 8 for the first three shells.
Total number of protons and neutrons in the nucleus.
Atom or group of atoms with an overall charge from losing or gaining electrons.
Number of protons in the nucleus; defines the element.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Atom”?
options: Total number of protons and neutrons in the nucleus.
Average mass of atoms of an element compared to 1/12 the mass of a C-12 atom.
Smallest unit of an element; consists of a nucleus of protons and neutrons surrounded by electrons.
Atom or group of atoms with an overall charge from losing or gaining electrons.

mcqs.q: How many neutrons in an atom with mass number 23 and atomic number 11?
options: 10 neutrons
12 neutrons
14 neutrons
11 neutrons
